name: psb-quality-checker
description: Comprehensive quality assurance system for the Professional Second Brain repository - validates fabrication, evidence, confidentiality, completeness, and consistency

commands.title: PSB: Check File Quality
commands.description: Validate a single markdown or YAML file for quality issues

commands.title: PSB: Audit Repository Quality
commands.description: Run comprehensive quality audit across the entire PSB repository

commands.title: PSB: Generate Quality Report
commands.description: Generate a detailed quality audit report with actionable recommendations

tools.name: check-quality
tools.description: Validate a markdown or YAML file for fabrication, evidence, confidentiality, completeness, consistency, and structure issues

filePath.description: Path to the file to check (markdown or YAML)

dimension.description: Specific dimension to check, or 'all' for comprehensive audit

verbose.description: Include detailed analysis and context in results

strictMode.description: Enable strict validation (treat warnings as critical)

tools.name: audit-repository
tools.description: Run comprehensive quality audit across the entire PSB repository

scope.description: Scope of audit (specific directory or entire repository)

generateSummary.description: Generate summary statistics and health scores

tools.name: generate-quality-report
tools.description: Generate detailed quality report with visualizations and improvement roadmap

filePath.description: File or directory path (required if scope is not 'repository')

includeHistorical.description: Include historical quality metrics if available

focusAreas.description: Specific dimensions to emphasize in report

tools.name: validate-metadata
tools.description: Validate YAML metadata files (projects.yml, skills.yml, etc.) for consistency and completeness

metadataType.description: Type of metadata file to validate

checkReferences.description: Verify cross-references between metadata and content files
